prompt: A clear editorial-style illustration of an AI agent as a small central control desk with a glowing language-model “brain” interpreting a task checklist, then directing visible tool arms toward separate panels: a web browser search, a folder of company files, a code terminal, a document editor, a calendar, and an email inbox; arrows form a loop from plan to action to observed result and back to the plan, showing multi-step decision-making. Around the desk, permissions appear as locked gates and limited-access badges, while high-consequence actions such as sending an email or changing an online account pause at a prominent human confirmation button. A transparent activity log records each step beside a large red stop switch and an undo/correction control, making the contrast between useful autonomy and carefully bounded, accountable action immediately legible.
